endpoint: Provider AD diagnosis versus provider control label from structural T1; research pilot only
primary_new_model: Equal arithmetic mean of the three validation-selected patient probability vectors
primary_comparator: Equal arithmetic mean of the unchanged c2/c4/c6 clinical-head patient probability vectors
individual_models: Report every new seed and c2/c4/c6, without choosing from external scores
new_slice_aggregation: softmax(mean of all nine two-class slice logits)
old_slice_aggregation: mean of the nine original clinical-head softmax probability vectors
decision_rule: AD if P_AD >= 0.5. Verify no exact0.5 old-comparator tie to retain its historical argmax decision.
calibration: No fitted calibration or threshold search; report raw patient NLL, binary Brier and fixed5-bin AD-probability reliability descriptively

harvard_fresh_external.role: Fresh source-heldout binary endpoint; no fitting or model selection; one of the published10AD has no released T1

besga_reused_test.role: Retrospectively reused internal patient test; original frozen partition preserved

openneuro_reused_external.role: Retrospectively reused external patients; one AD cannot establish stable sensitivity

stress_policy: Apply each fixed perturbation to every slice for all6 individual models, then compute both fixed ensembles; deterministic per patient/slice/scenario noise shared across models. Report every scenario per cohort; do not select checkpoints using outcomes. These are2D pixel diagnostics, not physical MRI acquisition simulations.
uncertainty: Two-sided95% exact binomial intervals for accuracy, AD sensitivity and CN specificity. Primary paired ensemble contrast and each newseed versus oldensemble use10,000 diagnosis-stratified paired patient bootstrap draws with fixed identity-derived seeds; conditional95% percentile intervals and exact paired McNemar discordance. Report unadjusted exploratory comparisons without multiplicity or clinical-superiority claims.
unit: One patient; nine slices and three seeds never count as additional patients
preprocessing: Existing unchanged exploratory_t1_axial_v1;1.5mm RAS, per-volume intensity scaling, fixed45-85% cranial-span fractions, aspect-preserving224PNG. No external-fitted normalization, cropping, harmonization or parameter adjustment.
quality_gate: Provider-derived source/diagnosis mapping, complete9-slice bags, allpatient gross anatomical review with diagnosis and predictions hidden, exact raw/canonical/pixel overlap audit, documented unavailableT1 and no silent exclusion before model inference
limitations: Convenience case-control cohorts and small source-heldout sample do not establish population risk calibration or real-world clinical readiness.
Source scanner and demographic confounding remain; no prospective study or clinician-adjudicated deployment validation.
Mean-logit and mean-probability systems differ in complete training and pooling pipelines; this is not an isolated architecture ablation.
MCI probabilities are descriptive, not binary accuracy, early-AD detection or progression prediction.
The original100 legacy stage images and neuroradiologist results are a different endpoint; this binary model is not scored against those four labels.
AlzaSet remains excluded while provider patient mapping and archive counts are unresolved.
